In this document, I'm going to recreate the *ternary graphs* for **Tucumã - Tucumã** and **Ucuuba - Buriti**.

## Tucumã-Tucumã

Lets start with **Tucumã-Tucumã**.

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false


getwd()

tucdata <- read.csv("C:/Users/luisr/Documentos/Documents/Documentos - Copia/NanoIA/planilhas/NanoTucumaTucuma.csv")

head(tucdata)

library(mixexp)

tucvar <- c("Tucuma", "Tucuma.1", "Brijo10")

tucmodel <- MixModel(tucdata, "PDI", mixcomps = tucvar, model = 2)

tucplot <- ModelPlot(model = tucmodel,
                     dimensions = list(x1 = "Tucuma", x2 = "Tucuma.1", x3 = "Brijo10"),
                     lims = c(0.1665,0.375,0.1665,0.375,0.165, 0.5835),
                     contour = TRUE,
                     at = c(0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 1),
                     pseudo = TRUE,
                     fill = TRUE,
                     main = "Tucumã - Tucumã",
                     axislabs = c("Tucumã", "Tucumã", "Brijo10"),
                     labels = TRUE)
```
